# Agentic tracking

Attribute calls to lines and credit leads.

SDK: runAttribution, TwilioSource, FileSource, D1Sink, StripeSink, FileSink.
CLI: agentic-tracking attribute --source call-file --file examples/calls.jsonl; defaults to a dry run.
MCP: attribute_calls, list_lines, list_sources, get_cost_report.
Docs: https://github.com/pooriaarab/agentic-tracking
Core: https://github.com/pooriaarab/agentic-tracking/blob/main/docs/agentic-core.md
License: MIT
